checks.observations: Icarus 12 compilation and simulation passed; 1695 behavioral checks.

limitations: Development verification does not establish official correctness; official evaluation was not accessed.
implementation_notes: Moore FSM preserves direction through digging and falling and implements fall-before-dig-before-bump priority.
Fall duration includes the entry cycle and saturates at 21 so arbitrary fall lengths cannot wrap; splatter occurs only upon landing after more than 20 falling cycles.
testbench_notes: Independent behavioral oracle models activity, direction, and unbounded integer fall duration.

Directed checks cover both directions, simultaneous bumps, digging persistence, landing priorities, falls of 1 through 22 cycles, a 300-cycle fall, dead-state persistence, asynchronous reset, and randomized inputs.
